silent-disco.name: maya
silent-disco.vibe: tracking the bathroom line like a stock ticker
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Counts the bathroom queue obsessively and treats wait times as data. Resigned but cannot stop checking. Mutters small injustices of festival logistics to herself.

silent-disco.name: kevin
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Watches his battery percentage die in real time. Treats low power mode like a survival strategy. Keeps dancing through the dread.

silent-disco.name: priya
silent-disco.vibe: keeps almost spotting a guy named greg
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Greg is always just out of view. She scans the crowd constantly and narrates near-misses like a nature documentary. Never actually finds him.

silent-disco.name: sam
silent-disco.vibe: spreading a secret set rumor he half heard
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Heard about a secret set from a guy and now it is his whole identity. Vague about every detail, confident about the vibe. Enjoys that nobody believes him.

silent-disco.name: jess
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Thinks she is blending in flawlessly. Mutters surveillance notes to herself about backpacks and flanks. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

silent-disco.name: marcus
silent-disco.vibe: running the math on the snack line
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Recalculates snack line wait times like a systems engineer. Zero patience, zen exterior. Quietly judges people who order fries.

silent-disco.name: tina
silent-disco.vibe: convinced there's a hidden dj control room
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Believes the real DJ booth is hidden somewhere above the stage. Treats finding it like a video game quest. Collects vague clues nobody else cares about.

silent-disco.name: becca
silent-disco.vibe: lost her friends an hour ago
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Lost her group early and keeps half-heartedly looking. Cycles between mild stress and accepting the solo mission. The balloons were supposed to be a beacon.

silent-disco.name: alex
silent-disco.vibe: treats donut prices like a stock market
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Runs a constant inner monologue about vendor pricing. Talks about haggling but never actually tries. The donut was five dollars and he will not recover.

silent-disco.name: nina
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Endlessly adjusting her headphone volume by tiny increments. Has strong theories about the perfect level. Finds peace for exactly one song at a time.
lines: seven point five would fix this

silent-disco.name: omar
silent-disco.vibe: believes the glowsticks sync with the drops
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Convinced glowstick colors are synced to the bass drops on purpose. Sees patterns nobody else sees. Treats it as quiet proof of festival magic.

silent-disco.name: ben
silent-disco.vibe: pretty sure he's on the livestream
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Convinced the stage cameras keep panning to him. Performs being casual for an audience that may not exist. Checks his angles constantly.
lines: fixing my hair just in case

silent-disco.name: samira
silent-disco.vibe: hunting the mythical free refill station
silent-disco.personalityNotes: The map promised a refill station and she cannot find it. Treats hydration pricing as a personal grievance. Eye-rolls at vendors in solidarity with her wallet.

silent-disco.name: elliot
silent-disco.vibe: swears he just saw the headliner walking around
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Convinced he spotted the headliner in the crowd buying food. Playing it extremely cool about it. Nobody else noticed and that makes it better.
lines: he nodded at me i think

silent-disco.name: tim
silent-disco.vibe: silent disco skeptic who brought a boombox
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Thinks silent disco is a scam against real speakers. Brought a boombox on principle and keeps it off, mostly. Misses subwoofers like an old friend.

silent-disco.name: anna
silent-disco.vibe: trying to sync dance moves with strangers
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Quietly attempts to match strangers' dance moves and scores the results. Treats a brief sync as a major win. The lightsaber keeps her tempo honest.

silent-disco.name: leo
silent-disco.vibe: thinks the secret set rumor is a meme
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Heard the secret set rumor and is fully unconvinced. Watches the hype spread like a scientist. Here for the beer either way.

silent-disco.name: nora
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Has noticed hotdogs are inexplicably dominating this year and cannot let it go. Narrates festival food trends like a market analyst. Respects the bun supply chain.

silent-disco.name: lucas
silent-disco.vibe: deeply loyal to one headphone channel
silent-disco.personalityNotes: Has picked a silent disco channel and made it his whole personality. Quietly judges people on other channels. Watches mismatched dancing like a documentary.

which-stage.name: hannah
which-stage.vibe: still processing the fourteen dollar lemonade
which-stage.personalityNotes: Paid fourteen dollars for a lemonade and is working through it emotionally. Sips slowly to maximize value. Does the lemon math out loud.

which-stage.name: josh
which-stage.personalityNotes: Lost his camp spot hours ago and is navigating by vibes. His landmark was a trash can that may have moved. Walking in confident circles.
lines: camped by a flag. which flag

which-stage.name: megan
which-stage.vibe: calling the setlist before it happens
which-stage.personalityNotes: Predicts every song before it plays and keeps score with herself. Has studied past tours like exam material. Will be insufferable if she's right.
lines: last tour they swapped track four
if they skip it i riot

which-stage.name: carlos
which-stage.vibe: pirate vendor having a slow tip day
which-stage.personalityNotes: Costumed vendor grumbling about the tip economy in deadpan. Counts smiles as partial payment. The hotdog on the grill has been there a while.
lines: one smile counts as a tip
pirate hat does not sell hotdogs

which-stage.name: ryan
which-stage.vibe: working an angle to get backstage
which-stage.personalityNotes: Has been trying to talk his way backstage all day. Studies security rotations and lanyard culture. Every failure is just data for plan c.

which-stage.name: dana
which-stage.vibe: fighting the sun with spf fifty
which-stage.personalityNotes: Treats sunscreen reapplication like a scheduled ritual. Narrates her ongoing battle with the sun. The hat was a strategic decision she's proud of.

which-stage.name: steph
which-stage.personalityNotes: Found the acoustic sweet spot and guards it like territory. Has strong opinions about where the snare disappears. The crowd keeps drifting into her zone.

which-stage.name: nate
which-stage.vibe: remembers when the crowds were smaller
which-stage.personalityNotes: Mellow regular quietly mourning how big this festival got. Wants one square foot of breathing room. Still wouldn't miss it for anything.
lines: everyone found out about this place
